# EmailX SwiftMail integration

Upstream: https://github.com/Cocoanetics/SwiftMail
Revision: `500a19f95c5ee3d3c7b8e81b615e1d66842f9ec4`. Original license is retained.

Local integration adds CHANGEDSINCE/MODSEQ metadata, QRESYNC result projection, bounded raw-body fetches, pipelined raw-body fetches, and byte-preserving APPEND. Existing command encoding, response parsing and connection handling are reused.
